data.name: 1,2-Dichlorobenzene with Water
measurement_methods: The measurements were made with samples contained in a stoppered Goetz tube placed in a constant temperature water bath.
The amount of solute dissolved was determined as the difference between total amount added and amount remaining in excess upon saturation.
mixing_methods: Equilibrium was assured through repeated shaking and centrifuging the mixture in the stoppered tube while it was temporarily removed from the water bath.

publication_references.citation: Booth, H.S.; Everson, H.E., Ind. Eng. Chem. 1948, 40, 1491-3.
